architecture: Two-branch MLP on hashed character n-gram features; not the original DeepDTA CNN.

split_manifest.label: kiba_score
split_manifest.representation: Supplied canonical SMILES, unchanged. Full protein sequence, unchanged.
split_manifest.score_scale: Original supplied KIBA score; no conversion to Kd, pKd or nM.
split_manifest.ordering: JSON insertion order; pair_index indexes row-major finite affinity entries.
split_manifest.split_policy: Original training fold 1 is validation; folds 2–5 are train; supplied test fold is untouched.
split_manifest.missing_values: NaN pairs excluded; finite zero scores retained.
split_manifest.length_policy: No truncation, filtering or padding. Select and document model length handling before training.
split_manifest.evaluation_limit: Pair-level split; compounds and proteins can overlap across partitions. Not a cold-drug or cold-protein benchmark.

preprocessing: Exact SMILES characters (1–4 grams) and full amino-acid sequence (1–3 grams); deterministic BLAKE2b hash; log counts, L2 normalisation, log length. No truncation or similarity inputs.
limitations: Pair-level held-out test: drugs/proteins may overlap training. No cold-drug/protein validation, experimental validation, or calibrated uncertainty. Hashed features lose global position and can collide. Predictions depend on SMILES representation; use the supplied canonical representation when available. KIBA scores are not Kd, pKd, nM or confidence percentages.
